description: Bilingual rental property management system for US landlords (1-10 units) featuring rent ledger, maintenance tickets, tasks, tenant portal, US state legal compliance center, and analytics. Phase 1 backend: Express + SQLite + JWT. No server-side Gemini/AI is implemented in phase 1, and photo hashes in seed data are sample values, not evidence.
name: Remix Small Landlord Assistant | 小房东租赁管理助手
